text: Core courses Principle of Marxist Philosophy, Principle of Marxist Political Economy, Political Science, World Political Economy and International Relations, Selected Classical Work of Marxism, Outline of Law, Marxist Ethics, Principle of Ideological and Political Education, Teaching Theory of Ideological and Political Education in Middle Schools and Contemporary China's Marxism. Objective This objective is to train students to be high-qualified specialized personnel who have higher political consciousness, ethical morality, and Marxism accomplishments; have the basic knowledge and theories of multi-disciplines such as philosophy, law, political science, management and pedagogy. After graduation, they will be able to work in intermediate schools and institutions of higher learning to teach the courses of Marxism Theory and Ideological and Political Education or do relevant researches work. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Law is granted.
